status_note: Industry association appeal confirmed at original association website. No government adoption or draft amendment verified. Existing 2027 ROP rules remain unchanged.
existing_law: PP RF No.1041 of 2024 as amended by PP RF No.258 of 2026 uses 2025/2026 coefficient table in 2026 and higher table starting 2027; art.24.2(4) Law 89-FZ becomes effective 2027-01-01 for recycling all packaging mass.
what_changed: No legal change. Plastics Processors Union (SPP) published on 2026-10-13 an appeal to Deputy PM D. Patrushev seeking to keep 2027 environmental fee coefficients at 2026 levels.
affected: Packaging producers, polymer processing industry, ROP obligated manufacturers/importers where packaging and group-specific coefficients apply.
dates: Appeal public 2026-10-13; current statutory transition scheduled 2027-01-01. No new official deadline from the appeal.
risk: Budget miscalculation if firms assume a future freeze is already adopted; material ROP cost exposure if planned coefficient increase remains.
industry_estimates: SPP claims cumulative burden increase: polypropylene +122%, composite carton +108%, other plastics packaging +131.1%. These are SPP estimates, not official tariffs.
what_mirlex_should_do: Track government response and any published draft or adopted amendment. For clients calculate 2027 ROP base-case under current law and separate unapproved lobbying scenario. Do not modify expert active rate tables or promise a freeze.
client_wording: Отраслевой союз предложил сохранить коэффициенты экологического сбора на 2027 год на уровне 2026 года. Решение об изменении действующих правил не подтверждено; при планировании расходов следует применять действующую нормативную базу.
publishability: Can report confirmed appeal as an industry signal with explicit no-NPA qualification. Do not report postponement as fact.
confirmation_phrase_for_unverified_legal: сигнал есть, подтверждение не найдено — не публиковать как факт
